buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Specialised coaching shall cover coaching for Military feeder institutes i. e. Sainik School, RMS, RIMC entrance, NDA examination orientatio n and also specialised concepts which will build lifelong skills of Children & Yout

h. 2. Coaching shall be provided by qualified and subject experts of past five year experienced faculties for conducting specialised coaching classes. 3. Trainer shall have relevant academic qualifications and teaching experie nce in their respective subjects and should submit subject wise trainer profiles, educational qualifications and experience certificates before commencement. 4. Mathematics, English, General Knowledge, General Science and Reasoni ng faculties shall be provided as per the course requirements. 5. Separate Sainik School, RMS, RIMC entrance, NDA orientation sessions s hall cover Mathematics, General Ability Test, examination pattern and preparati on strategies. 6. Subject wise one teacher shall be provided for conduct specialised coac hing classes. 7. Course program shall cover relevant subjects as well as important guidelines required for applying & clearing all India Sainik School, RMS, RIMC & NDA exam scheduled in Apr 2027. 8. Replacement of any trainer should require prior approval of the organisa tion. 9. Training shall be provided in smart offline mode. 10. Coaching shall be completed within the stipulated time period. 11. Coaching duration shall be minimum two hours daily for 60 days excludi ng Holiday /Sunday. 12. Classes shall be conducted according to an approved timetable and cour se curriculum.

13. Study materials shall be new, unused and free from printed defects. 14. All Stationery items and subject wise study materials should be supplied in complete sets as per the approved list. 15. No pirated, unauthorised or photocopied copyrighted books shall be pro vided. 16. Study materials shall be English or Hindi as specified by the organisation & contents of the books should be relevant to the latest applicable examination syllabus. 17. Design and content of the flex should be approved by the organisation b efore printing and also provide installation and fixing arrangements. 18. Refreshments like Samosa, Biscuits, Tea/ Coffee, Package drinking wate r (330 ml), disposal cup and plates include napkin paper should be provided to 25 students for 60 days (Excluding Sunday/ Holiday) during coaching classes as per the approved daily schedule. 19. Eatables shall be freshly prepared, hygienically handled and suitable for immediate consumption. 20. Eatables shall have uniform size/shape, properly cooked covering, adequ ately cooked filling and free from staleness, abnormal odour, contamination, ex cessive oiliness, fungal growth, foreign material, burning or undercooking. 21. Transportation and supply shall be in clean, covered and food-safe conta iners under hygienic conditions and Items shall be in factory-sealed food-grade packs and comply with applicable FSSAI food safety and labelling requirements. 22. Each pack shall bear batch number, manufacturing/packing date, expiry/b est-before date and manufacturer details. Minimum remaining shelf life shall be 75% of declared shelf life or 6 months, whichever is less. 23. The adequate quantity and timely distribution shall be ensured during th e training sessions. 24. Consumable Items shall be manufactured by a registered company.

25. The bidder shall provide a course completion certificate to every students upon successful completion of the 60 days course. 26. Any bidder failing to fulfil any of the above-mentioned requirements shal l be disqualified from participating in the bid. 27. Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor code creation: (a) Copy of Pan Card (b) Copy of GSTIN. (c) Copy of Cancelled Cheque. (d) Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by bank 28. The bidder must clearly mention the name of the respective document on each uploaded pdf file: Example: (a) Experience Criteria - (b) Past Performance (c) Bidder Turnover . 2.
